text: Do you have any personal or family history of colorectal cancer or inflammatory bowel disease, and have you noticed any unintentional weight loss or fatigue?

text: My main symptom is Rectal bleeding daily with bowel movements. I also have No pain with defecation.

text: Does the blood appear bright red and separate from the stool, or is it dark and mixed in? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in the caliber of your stool, such as it becoming narrower?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the palpable rectal mass and your history of five vaginal deliveries, I suspect a rectal prolapse or an internal hemorrhoid. REQUEST TEST: Digital Rectal Exam

text: The proctoscopy confirms internal hemorrhoids as the source of bleeding. Given that the mass is reducible and non-tender, this is consistent with Grade I or II internal hemorrhoids. DIAGNOSIS READY: Internal Hemorrhoids
